storage: git-versioned JSONL datacore/sentinel2/readings_v2.jsonl (one line per scene; dedup by scene)
written_by: scripts/tankfill_estimator.py (Python, session-run; never on Railway — see cot.json _note on envelope-test coverage of Python writers)
source: PR-2 master chips (datacore/manifests/sentinel2chips.json) x OSM tank registry (cushing_tanks.geojson, ODbL)
license: Copernicus free/open data policy (imagery) + ODbL (registry geometry); attribution both
attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; tank geometry © OpenStreetMap contributors

field_map.sun_elev/sun_azim: solar angles the estimate is conditioned on
field_map.registration: integer content shift vs the reference chip {dx, dy, r}
field_map.sites[]: site, n_tanks, fill_d2w (D^2-weighted mean fill), fill_median — the candidate signal level
field_map.tanks[]: per-tank LOW-CONFIDENCE: id, site, d_m, ratio (up-sun/down-sun), depth_m, fill, px, q (ok|subpixel), height_src
field_map.assumptions: shadow_k + default shell height carried on every reading
field_map.label: EXPERIMENTAL marker (ladder gate 1 not attempted)

confidence_model: EXPERIMENTAL derived estimate, assumption-laden (shadow_k=0.35, API-650 default heights). Per-tank q flags sub-pixel readings (expected full-depth reach < 0.5 px — summer high sun); winter scenes carry ~5x more signal. Gate-1 criteria pre-stated in the TANK-FILL v2 workup (open_questions.md); until PASS nothing here is a SIGNAL and nothing surfaces on /data.
cadence: per usable scene (~weekly after clouds), session-run
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). Tank-fill v2 PR-3 of 7; PR-4 = backfill + gate-1 attempt vs EIA weekly Cushing stocks.
